items.text: The TCO is open from Monday to Saturday and is closed on Sundays.

items.label: E2
items.text: The Travel Card Office (TCO) issues all concession cards and replaces lost travel cards. A replacement card costs 5 euros.

items.label: E3
items.text: Travel assistance at stations must be booked at least 24 hours in advance.

items.label: E4
items.text: A single ride ticket is valid for 90 minutes after validation.

items.label: E5
items.text: Items found on vehicles are kept for 30 days at the central depot.
